description: Clock multiplier with eight outputs, five of which can be shuffled, slipped and made to skip beats

params.text: Shifts which multiple each output carries, walking the set of eight round
Pushes the shuffled outputs off the beat, from none at the bottom to almost a whole period at the top
Sets how the shuffle falls: the lower half of the travel sets a group length of two to six beats with none slipped, and the upper half slips one to four beats of each group
Chooses which beats the shuffled outputs leave out, working through a table of patterns, and above the centre the pattern is turned inside out
Sets the width of every output pulse as a share of the incoming clock's period
Multiplies every output by a further four

inputs.text: The clock being multiplied, read high above 0.5V
A rising edge above 0.5V puts every output back to the start of its cycle
Adds to the ROTATE knob, 5V covering the whole range
Adds to the SLIP knob, 5V covering the whole range
Adds to the SHUFFLE knob, 5V covering the whole range
Adds to the SKIP knob, 5V covering the whole range
Adds to the PW knob, 5V covering the whole range
Above 2.5V this jack reverses the 4X FAST button, so the four times multiplication runs when the button is off
Above 2.5V this jack reverses the MUTE button, so the outputs are held down when the button is off and let through when it is on

outputs.text: An 8V gate at a whole multiple of the incoming clock, with SKIP, SHUFFLE and SLIP passing it by
An 8V gate at a whole multiple of the incoming clock, shifted by SHUFFLE and SLIP and thinned out by SKIP

notes: The multiple printed beside an output is what it carries with ROTATE fully anticlockwise, nothing in the rotate jack and 4X FAST off.
Nothing comes out until the module has seen two clock edges: the first sets the period it multiplies, and the outputs stop again if a clock is more than two periods late.
